dataset: PRIMARY malicious (360) + v4 size-matched negatives, TRUE predecessor features (entropy_before, ast_nodes_before, delta_*)
framing: Version-context value measured on the primary malicious pairs (360, identical to the detection experiment) under a within-package control design, using the true predecessor features (entropy_before, ast_nodes_before, delta_*) available for these pairs. Controls are same-package negatives. The gain is the drop in PR-AUC when the predecessor is replaced by a shuffled or wrong-package predecessor.
relationship_to_detector: The detector headline (ROC-AUC 0.801) uses size-matched CLEAN controls, which do not carry predecessor features; the version-context experiment necessarily uses same-package controls that do. Both use the same 360 malicious pairs.
